title: Weak-field SLSE relaxation of 35Cl in sodium chlorate
citation: C. Chen et al., Journal of Magnetic Resonance 311, 106660 (2020)
temperature_note: Nominal normalization value; the paper reports room temperature rather than an exact temperature for Table 1.
uncertainty_note: Table 1 does not report pointwise standard uncertainties for T2_SLSE.
model_boundary: Field-dependent spectral overlap is predicted from the quadrupolar plus Zeeman Hamiltonian. The field-independent rate and zero-field flip-flop strength are fitted nuisance parameters.
